name: Algebraic Energy Equation Substitution
description: Replaces the search for a graph triangle with an algebraically equivalent condition E(a,b)+E(b,c)+E(c,a) = 2(a^2+b^2+c^2), where E(x,y)=x^2+y^2 if the pair exists and 0 otherwise. Models must deduce that this equation is strictly equivalent to all three pairs existing; failure to do so leads to O(N^3) brute force and TLE, while success allows the intended O(NM/64) bitset intersection algorithm.
